Invite new users and review your current users from within the user directory. Users belong to groups which determine which records they can see, and have roles with attached permissions which define the level of access they have to features.

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] You are a [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble} or assigned another role with sufficient permissions to perform the tasks in this guide.[^1] 

:::

## View and search for users

View a list of users in your organization that have access to the {{< var validmind.platform >}}: 

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa users >}} Users & Access, select **User Directory**.

    Search the list of Organization Users by typing a keyword into the **{{< fa magnifying-glass >}} Search by name, email, title, or role...** box.

## Manage user invitations

Invite users in your organization to the {{< var validmind.platform >}}:

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa users >}} Users & Access, select **Invite New Users**.

::: {.panel-tabset}

To onboard many users at once, use the Public REST API. In one call, you can invite a user with their groups and roles, or add an existing user to several groups.[^5]

## View and edit user fields

If your organization has added user fields,[^6] you can show them as columns in the User Directory and edit their values on each user's detail page.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Show user fields in the User Directory

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa users >}} Users & Access, select **User Directory**.

3. Click **{{< fa table >}} Manage Columns** and turn on the user fields you want to see.

    User field columns are off by default. Your column choices are saved for you and don't affect other users. You can sort by a user field column, and search also matches user field values.

### Edit user field values

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa users >}} Users & Access, select **User Directory**.

3. Click the user whose values you want to change.

    Their user fields appear below their name and email. Empty values are blank.

4. Click a user field value, enter the new value, and click **Save**.

    To clear a value, delete the text and click **Save**.

You can edit any user's values if your role allows you to update users, such as [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble}. You can always edit your own values on your profile.[^7]

:::

## Disable users

::: {.callout-important title="Disabling users is permanent and cannot be undone."}
To allow users access to your organization again, including providing valid API keys and secrets, you must re-invite them.[^3]

:::

To remove a user from your organization, revoking their access and any API keys and secrets:[^4]

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa users >}} Users & Access, select **User Directory**.

3. Hover over the user you want to remove from your organization.

4. Under the Actions column, click **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** and select **{{< fa user-minus >}} Disable**.

5. Select **Disable** to confirm removal of the selected user from your organization.
